neighbours.label: ' a' straight after 'conduct' or 'perform' when an investigation noun is coming (conduct a survey, perform a regression), as opposed to ' a' with other verbs on the same topics
fire: Before signing the lease, conduct a careful review of every clause.
Our team conducted a randomized trial across twelve hospitals.
Smith and colleagues performed a meta-analysis of published data.
Engineers will perform a stress test on the bridge next month.
The agency is conducting a survey of local business owners.
To check the claim, we performed a regression on the sales figures.
The auditors must conduct a full audit of the accounts.
Students will conduct a small experiment on plant growth.
quiet: Ahead of signing, she read a careful review of every clause.
Our team published a randomized trial from twelve hospitals.
Smith and colleagues cited a meta-analysis of published data.
Engineers discussed a stress test on the bridge last month.
The agency has released a survey of local business owners.
To check the claim, we downloaded a spreadsheet of the sales figures.
The auditors received a full copy of the accounts.
Students will read a short chapter on plant growth.

notes: Probes: 'conducted a choir' fired too (0.77) but 'performed a symphony' did not (0.005), so the 'investigation' part of this label is not established; the verb may be enough.
